intent.raw_query: Bali for solo traveler, $1500 budget, beaches and yoga, July 2026 from LA

experiences.name: Sunrise Yoga at Campuhan Ridge Walk
experiences.description: Join an open-air sunrise yoga session overlooking the lush Campuhan valley, followed by a peaceful walk along the iconic ridge trail surrounded by tropical greenery. Many local instructors offer donation-based or affordable classes here.

experiences.name: Seminyak Beach Sunset & Surf Lesson
experiences.description: Take a beginner surf lesson on the golden sands of Seminyak Beach, then relax and watch one of Bali's legendary sunsets. Board rentals and instructors are widely available along the beach strip at budget-friendly rates.

experiences.name: Multi-Day Yoga Retreat at The Yoga Barn
experiences.description: Attend multiple drop-in yoga and meditation classes over several days at Bali's most renowned wellness center. Choose from Hatha, Vinyasa, Yin, and sound healing sessions in a serene jungle setting with world-class instructors.

experiences.name: Nusa Dua Crystal-Clear Beach Day
experiences.description: Spend a full day at the pristine, calm waters of Nusa Dua Beach. Ideal for swimming, snorkeling, and relaxing on white sand. Rent a sun lounger, explore the coral reefs just offshore, and enjoy fresh seafood from beachside warungs.

experiences.name: Balinese Cooking Class & Ubud Market Tour
experiences.description: Start with a guided tour of Ubud's traditional morning market to source fresh local ingredients, then learn to prepare authentic Balinese dishes like satay lilit, lawar, and black rice pudding under the guidance of a local chef.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Bali
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Ngurah Rai Airport, clear customs and immigration. Take a pre-booked budget shuttle or shared Grab ride to Campuhan Ridge, Ubud Boutique Stay (~1.5–2 hrs). Check in, freshen up, and take a gentle stroll along the iconic Campuhan Ridge Walk — a free, scenic 9 km trail with panoramic rice field and jungle views right from the hotel's doorstep.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the nearby Ubud town center on foot. Browse the Ubud Art Market for local crafts and souvenirs. Settle into the Bali pace with a relaxed dinner at a warung (local eatery) on Jalan Dewisita.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the airport before landing or grab a snack on the plane.
meals.lunch: Grab a quick bite at the airport or a roadside warung en route to Ubud — nasi goreng or mie goreng for ~IDR 25,000–40,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Biah Biah on Jalan Goutama — authentic Balinese cuisine, budget-friendly (~IDR 40,000–70,000 per dish).

day_by_day.notes: Pre-book a shared shuttle from the airport to Ubud for ~IDR 100,000–150,000 per person to save money vs. private taxi. Download Grab app for local rides.

day_by_day.morning: Start the day with a free sunrise yoga session on the hotel terrace or a self-guided morning meditation walk along Campuhan Ridge Walk (best at 6:00–7:30 AM before heat). Enjoy the mist over the jungle canopy.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary in central Ubud (entry ~IDR 80,000). Walk through ancient temple grounds and observe Balinese long-tailed macaques in their natural habitat. Afterward, explore Jalan Hanoman for local boutiques and warungs.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Kecak Fire Dance performance at Pura Dalem Ubud or Arma Museum (~IDR 100,000–150,000). This is a must-see Balinese cultural experience set against a dramatic sunset backdrop.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the hotel or nearby Cafe Wayan — try bubur ayam (rice porridge) or banana pancakes (~IDR 30,000–50,000).
meals.lunch: Warung Ibu Oka near the Monkey Forest — famous for babi guling (suckling pig) at ~IDR 50,000–80,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Teges on Jalan Raya Ubud — local nasi campur (mixed rice plate) for ~IDR 30,000–50,000.

day_by_day.notes: Wear closed-toe shoes at the Monkey Forest and keep bags zipped — monkeys are curious and may grab loose items. Bring a light rain jacket as July can bring brief afternoon showers.

day_by_day.morning: Join a budget morning yoga class at Yoga Barn in Ubud (~IDR 130,000–170,000 per drop-in class). One of Bali's most renowned yoga centers, offering Hatha, Vinyasa, and Yin styles in an open-air jungle setting. Classes start at 7:00 AM.
day_by_day.afternoon: Walk or take a short ride to Tegallalang Rice Terraces (~8 km north of Ubud). Free to enter the outer terraces; some viewing spots charge a small donation (~IDR 10,000–20,000). Explore the stunning UNESCO-listed stepped paddies and take photos. Stop at a local warung for coconut water.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud town. Stroll through the Ubud Night Market (Pasar Senggol) for cheap local street food and fresh tropical fruit.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast at Yoga Barn café post-class — smoothie bowl or avocado toast (~IDR 50,000–80,000).
meals.lunch: Warung at Tegallalang — fresh grilled corn, satay sticks, or nasi goreng with a view (~IDR 30,000–50,000).
meals.dinner: Ubud Night Market — try various street foods like martabak (stuffed pancake), sate lilit, and fresh juices for ~IDR 50,000–80,000 total.

day_by_day.notes: Yoga Barn offers a 10-class pass for better value if you plan to attend multiple sessions. Book classes online in advance during peak July season.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning visit to Tirta Empul Temple (Holy Spring Water Temple) ~13 km from Ubud (~IDR 50,000 entry + sarong rental if needed). Witness or participate in the sacred Hindu purification ritual (melukat) in the holy spring pools — a deeply spiritual Balinese experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the nearby Gunung Kawi Temple complex (~IDR 50,000 entry) — ancient 11th-century royal shrines carved into cliff faces surrounded by rice terraces. Walk the 300-step descent through lush jungle. Explore at a leisurely pace.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Campuhan Ridge area. Enjoy a sunset walk along the ridge trail and watch the sky turn golden over the Wos River valley. Wind down with a traditional Balinese massage.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at hotel or a local warung near Campuhan — nasi goreng with egg (~IDR 25,000–35,000).
meals.lunch: Warung near Gunung Kawi — simple rice dishes and fresh coconut (~IDR 30,000–50,000).
meals.dinner: Warung Sopa on Jalan Sugriwa — vegetarian-friendly Balinese food with great value (~IDR 40,000–70,000).

day_by_day.notes: Wear modest clothing (shoulders and knees covered) at both temples. Sarongs are available for rent/loan at the entrance. Arrive at Tirta Empul before 9 AM to avoid crowds.

day_by_day.morning: Take a budget day trip to Amed Beach on Bali's east coast (~2.5 hrs from Ubud). Arrange a shared shuttle or rent a scooter (~IDR 80,000–100,000/day). Arrive at Amed's black sand beaches — ideal for snorkeling directly from shore. Rent snorkel gear (~IDR 50,000) and explore the vibrant coral reefs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue snorkeling or relax on the quiet Amed beach. Visit the famous USAT Liberty Shipwreck at nearby Tulamben (~20 min from Amed) — one of the world's most accessible wreck dives, also snorkelable in shallow sections. Entry free; snorkel gear rental ~IDR 50,000.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the sunset over Mount Agung from Amed beach — spectacular views. Head back to Ubud by shared shuttle or scooter. Freshen up and have a quiet dinner.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at hotel before departure (~6:30 AM).
meals.lunch: Warung on Amed beach — fresh grilled fish, rice, and vegetables (~IDR 50,000–80,000).
meals.dinner: Warung Bernadette or local warung near Campuhan on return — nasi campur (~IDR 35,000–55,000).

day_by_day.notes: This is a long day — start by 7:00 AM. If renting a scooter, ensure you have an international driving permit. Shared shuttles from Ubud to Amed cost ~IDR 100,000–150,000 per person each way. Bring reef-safe sunscreen.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning. Enjoy a slow breakfast and a self-practice yoga or stretching session at the hotel. Take a gentle walk along Campuhan Ridge at sunrise to recharge after the Amed day trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Ubud's cultural side — visit the Neka Art Museum (~IDR 75,000) or the Agung Rai Museum of Art (ARMA, ~IDR 80,000) to discover traditional and contemporary Balinese art. Both are within easy walking or cycling distance from Campuhan.
day_by_day.evening: Take a traditional Balinese cooking class in the evening (~IDR 250,000–350,000 for a budget class) — learn to make classic dishes like lawar, sate, and black rice pudding. Many classes include a market visit and full dinner.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or Kafe Batan Waru on Jalan Dewisita — full Balinese breakfast (~IDR 50,000–70,000).
meals.lunch: Warung Mendez or a simple warung near ARMA — light lunch of gado-gado or mie goreng (~IDR 30,000–45,000).
meals.dinner: Eat what you cook in the cooking class — included in most class fees.

day_by_day.notes: Book the cooking class a day in advance. Look for classes offered by local families for the most authentic and budget-friendly experience (~IDR 250,000 vs. resort classes at IDR 500,000+).

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Seminyak and Kuta beaches (~1.5 hrs from Ubud by shared shuttle). Arrive at Seminyak Beach — a beautiful stretch of golden sand. Enjoy a morning beach walk, swim in the warm Indian Ocean, and soak up the sun.
day_by_day.afternoon: Walk south along the beach to Kuta Beach — Bali's most famous surf beach. Watch local surfers and consider a beginner surf lesson (~IDR 150,000–200,000 for a 1-hour lesson including board rental). Kuta is ideal for first-timers with gentle rolling waves.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the legendary Kuta sunset — one of Bali's most spectacular. Browse the Kuta night market or Beachwalk Mall food court for budget dinner options before the shuttle back to Ubud.

meals.breakfast: Eat at hotel before departing early (~7:00 AM).
meals.lunch: Warung on Seminyak or Kuta beach — fresh seafood, nasi goreng (~IDR 40,000–70,000).
meals.dinner: Kuta Night Market or Beachwalk food court — wide variety of local food from ~IDR 30,000–60,000 per dish.

day_by_day.notes: Shared shuttle Ubud–Kuta/Seminyak costs ~IDR 80,000–120,000 per person. Book return shuttle in advance. The sea at Kuta can have strong currents — only swim in flagged zones and heed lifeguard warnings.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga session at Yoga Barn or Radiantly Alive Yoga Studio in Ubud (~IDR 130,000–170,000 drop-in). Try a different style — Yin Yoga or Pranayama breathwork for variety. Afterward, enjoy a smoothie at the studio café.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent a bicycle (~IDR 50,000–80,000/day) and cycle through Ubud's surrounding villages. Explore Penestanan village (artists' colony), Sayan village, and the lush Sayan Valley — all accessible from Campuhan Ridge. Stop at local warungs and small temples along the way.
day_by_day.evening: Visit Pura Taman Saraswati (Lotus Temple) in central Ubud — free to view the exterior, stunning lotus pond. Check if there's a traditional Legong dance performance at the temple (~IDR 100,000).

meals.breakfast: Post-yoga smoothie bowl at Yoga Barn café or Clear Café on Jalan Hanoman (~IDR 50,000–80,000).
meals.lunch: Warung in Penestanan village during the cycling route — simple home-cooked Balinese meal (~IDR 25,000–40,000).
meals.dinner: Warung Pulau Kelapa on Jalan Goutama — excellent local food at great prices (~IDR 40,000–65,000).

day_by_day.notes: Cycling around Ubud's back roads is one of the best free/cheap activities. Wear sunscreen and carry water. The terrain around Campuhan is hilly but manageable.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning hike up Mount Batur volcano (~2 hrs from Ubud). Join a budget guided sunrise trek (~IDR 300,000–450,000 including guide and transport). Depart Ubud by 2:00 AM to reach the summit by sunrise at ~5:30 AM. The 1,717m active volcano offers breathtaking panoramic views.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend Mount Batur and stop at natural hot springs (Toya Devasya or local springs ~IDR 50,000–100,000) to soak tired muscles. Return to Ubud by early afternoon and rest.
day_by_day.evening: Relaxed evening in Ubud. Treat yourself to a traditional Balinese massage (~IDR 80,000–120,000 for 1 hour at a local spa) to recover from the hike. Early night.

meals.breakfast: Pre-hike snack pack from guide (usually included) or eat at the summit — simple breakfast with a volcano view.
meals.lunch: Warung near Batur or on the road back to Ubud — nasi campur (~IDR 35,000–50,000).
meals.dinner: Light dinner at hotel area warung — soup, vegetables, and rice (~IDR 30,000–50,000).

day_by_day.notes: This is a physically demanding day — wear layers (summit can be cool at 4–5°C at night), bring a headlamp, and wear sturdy shoes. Book the guided trek the day before. Avoid unlicensed guides.

day_by_day.morning: Rest morning after the volcano hike. Sleep in, enjoy a slow hotel breakfast, and do gentle stretching or restorative yoga on the hotel terrace. Rehydrate and recover.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Campuhan area more deeply — visit Pura Gunung Lebah temple at the base of Campuhan Ridge (free entry, small donation appreciated). Walk along the Wos River trail below the ridge. Visit local silver and batik workshops in the area.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a full moon or regular evening ceremony at a local Balinese temple if timing aligns (ask hotel staff). Otherwise, enjoy a cultural show — Barong Dance at Pura Dalem Ubud (~IDR 100,000). Dinner at a riverside warung.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely hotel breakfast or Juice Ja Café near Campuhan — fresh tropical juices and toast (~IDR 40,000–60,000).
meals.lunch: Warung near Campuhan Ridge — light lunch of gado-gado or fresh spring rolls (~IDR 30,000–45,000).
meals.dinner: Warung di Uma on Jalan Raya Campuhan — local dishes with a riverside ambiance (~IDR 45,000–70,000).

day_by_day.notes: Day 10 is intentionally lighter to allow full recovery from the Mount Batur hike. Use this time to do laundry (local laundry services cost ~IDR 15,000–20,000/kg) and repack.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Nusa Lembongan island (~1.5 hrs from Sanur by fast boat). Take a shared shuttle from Ubud to Sanur (~IDR 60,000–80,000), then a budget fast boat (~IDR 200,000–300,000 return). Arrive at Nusa Lembongan and rent a bicycle or scooter to explore the island.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Dream Beach and Devil's Tear on the island's rugged west coast — dramatic cliffs, crashing waves, and stunning ocean views. Swim at the calmer Sandy Bay Beach. Snorkel around the mangroves or at Mushroom Bay (~IDR 50,000 for gear rental).
day_by_day.evening: Watch the sunset from the beach at Mushroom Bay or Jungut Batu village. Take the late afternoon boat back to Sanur and shared shuttle to Ubud. Arrive back in Ubud by 8–9 PM.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast before departure (~6:30 AM) at hotel or Sanur warung.
meals.lunch: Warung on Nusa Lembongan — fresh grilled fish, calamari, or nasi goreng (~IDR 50,000–90,000).
meals.dinner: Quick dinner at Sanur before shuttle or at a warung near hotel on return (~IDR 35,000–55,000).

day_by_day.notes: Book fast boat tickets in advance during July (peak season). Depart Ubud by 7:00 AM to catch the morning boat. Bring cash as ATMs on Lembongan have limited availability. Reef-safe sunscreen is essential.

day_by_day.morning: Final full yoga morning — attend a special 2-hour workshop at Yoga Barn or Radiantly Alive (~IDR 200,000–300,000) such as Ashtanga, Sound Healing, or Yoga Nidra. A meaningful way to deepen the yoga experience before the trip ends.
day_by_day.afternoon: Last afternoon in Ubud — revisit favorite spots, shop for budget souvenirs at Ubud Art Market (bargain for best prices — aim for 50% of asking price), and pick up Balinese coffee, vanilla, or traditional textiles as gifts.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at a slightly nicer but still budget-friendly restaurant in Ubud. Enjoy a final Campuhan Ridge sunset walk. Pack and prepare for departure.

meals.breakfast: Post-yoga smoothie and açaí bowl at Yoga Barn café (~IDR 60,000–90,000).
meals.lunch: Warung Ibu Oka or Warung Babi Guling Pak Malen — treat yourself to Ubud's famous suckling pig one last time (~IDR 60,000–90,000).
meals.dinner: Locavore To Go (budget version of the famous Locavore) on Jalan Dewisita — creative Indonesian street food ~IDR 60,000–100,000 per dish.

day_by_day.notes: Bargaining at the Ubud Art Market is expected and part of the culture — start at 40–50% of the quoted price and meet in the middle. Avoid buying on the first quote.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise walk along Campuhan Ridge — a peaceful goodbye to Ubud's beautiful landscape. Pack remaining belongings, check out of the hotel, and store luggage if needed. Enjoy a last Balinese breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrange shared shuttle or Grab ride from Ubud to Ngurah Rai Airport (~1.5–2 hrs). Allow at least 3 hours before your flight for the journey and check-in. Browse duty-free shops at the airport for last-minute Bali coffee or snacks.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Bali — reflect on 13 incredible days of beaches, yoga, culture, and adventure. Safe travels!

meals.breakfast: Final breakfast at a favorite Ubud warung — nasi goreng, fresh fruit, and Balinese coffee (~IDR 30,000–50,000).
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the airport or grab a meal before departure at a warung near the airport (~IDR 40,000–70,000).
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or airport restaurant depending on departure time.

day_by_day.notes: Check out time is typically 11:00 AM — confirm with the hotel. Shared shuttle to the airport from Ubud costs ~IDR 100,000–150,000 per person. Book in advance to guarantee a seat. Keep some IDR cash for last tips and airport expenses.

trip_options.title: Classic Bali Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Transfer from airport to Campuhan Ridge, Ubud Boutique Stay (~1.5 hrs). Check in, freshen up, and take a gentle introductory walk along the iconic Campuhan Ridge Walk to soak in the rolling green hills and river valley views
day_by_day.evening: Stroll into central Ubud for a relaxed first evening. Explore Jalan Hanoman street, browse local art shops, and settle in for dinner

meals.breakfast: N/A — in transit
meals.lunch: Grab a meal at the airport or a quick stop en route (e.g., Warung Men Weti near Ubud for local nasi campur ~IDR 35,000)
meals.dinner: Locavore NXT, Ubud — mid-range plant-forward Indonesian cuisine with creative local ingredients (~IDR 180,000–250,000 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light — jet lag may be a factor. Confirm hotel check-in time in advance. Exchange some cash to IDR on arrival or use airport ATM.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga session at the hotel or join a class at Yoga Barn Ubud (one of Bali's most renowned yoga studios, ~10 min drive). Choose a 90-min Hatha or Vinyasa class starting at 07:30 or 09:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary in central Ubud (~15 min drive), then explore the Ubud Art Market and Ubud Palace (Puri Saren Agung) nearby
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Kecak Fire Dance performance at Ubud Palace (starts ~19:30, tickets ~IDR 100,000)

meals.breakfast: Café Wayan, Ubud — fresh fruit, Balinese pancakes, and local coffee (~IDR 60,000–90,000)
meals.lunch: Warung Ibu Oka — famous Balinese suckling pig (babi guling), a must-try local institution (~IDR 65,000–85,000)
meals.dinner: Bridges Bali Restaurant, Campuhan — elegant setting over the river gorge, Indonesian and international menu (~IDR 200,000–300,000)

day_by_day.notes: Book Yoga Barn classes online in advance as popular morning slots fill quickly. Wear comfortable shoes for the Monkey Forest — keep bags zipped around the monkeys.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise visit to Tirta Empul Temple (holy spring water temple, ~25 min drive from Ubud). Observe or participate in the melukat purification ritual. Dress respectfully — sarong and sash required (available for rent at entrance)
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Tegallalang Rice Terraces (~20 min drive) for a scenic walk among UNESCO-recognized subak irrigation landscapes. Optional: ATV ride or swing experience at the terraces
day_by_day.evening: Return to Campuhan Ridge area. Sunset drinks and relaxation at the hotel, followed by a quiet dinner close to the property

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at hotel or pack fruit and snacks for the sunrise temple visit
meals.lunch: Warung Bodag Maliah at Tegallalang — local Indonesian dishes with rice terrace views (~IDR 50,000–80,000)
meals.dinner: Room4Dessert or Mozaic Restaurant Ubud (book ahead) — creative tasting menus, mid-to-upper mid-range (~IDR 250,000–400,000)

day_by_day.notes: Arrive at Tirta Empul before 08:00 to beat crowds and experience a more serene atmosphere. Bring a change of clothes if participating in the water purification.

day_by_day.morning: Morning meditation and pranayama (breathwork) session at Yoga Barn or The Yoga House Ubud. Follow with a healthy smoothie bowl breakfast at a nearby café
day_by_day.afternoon: Day trip to Besakih Temple (Mother Temple of Bali, ~1.5 hrs from Ubud) — Bali's largest and most sacred Hindu temple complex on the slopes of Mount Agung
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud. Enjoy a traditional Balinese massage at a local spa (e.g., Karsa Spa or Taksu Spa, ~IDR 150,000–200,000 for 60 min)

meals.breakfast: Kafe, Ubud — organic smoothie bowls, avocado toast, and cold-pressed juices (~IDR 70,000–110,000)
meals.lunch: Warung near Besakih or packed lunch — simple nasi goreng or mie goreng (~IDR 30,000–50,000)
meals.dinner: Hujan Locale, Ubud — modern Indonesian cuisine in a beautiful garden setting (~IDR 180,000–260,000)

day_by_day.notes: Hire a private driver for the Besakih trip (~IDR 400,000–500,000 for the day) as public transport is limited. Guides at Besakih are mandatory for temple access — negotiate fee upfront (~IDR 50,000–100,000).

day_by_day.morning: Travel south to Seminyak/Canggu area (~1.5 hrs from Ubud). Check into a day-use arrangement or simply arrive for beach time. Morning surf lesson on Batu Bolong Beach or Echo Beach in Canggu (beginner-friendly, lessons ~IDR 300,000–400,000 including board)
day_by_day.afternoon: Beach relaxation at Batu Bolong Beach. Rent a sun lounger, swim, and enjoy the laid-back Canggu surf scene. Explore the trendy cafés and boutiques along Jalan Batu Bolong
day_by_day.evening: Sunset at La Brisa Beach Club or Finn's Beach Club, Canggu — cocktails with ocean views. Return to Ubud in the evening

meals.breakfast: Quick bite en route — Revolver Espresso or Shelter Café, Canggu (~IDR 60,000–90,000)
meals.lunch: Warung Dandelion, Canggu — healthy bowls, wraps, and fresh juices (~IDR 80,000–120,000)
meals.dinner: Betelnut Café, Seminyak — Asian fusion in a garden setting (~IDR 150,000–220,000), then return to Ubud

day_by_day.notes: July is dry season in Bali — beach days will be sunny and ideal. Wear reef-safe sunscreen. Arrange a reliable driver for the Ubud–Canggu day trip (~IDR 500,000–600,000 round trip).

day_by_day.morning: Early morning Campuhan Ridge Walk at sunrise (~06:00) — the ridge is magical in the early morning light with mist over the valleys. Pack light and bring water
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the ARMA Museum (Agung Rai Museum of Art) in Ubud — excellent collection of Balinese and Indonesian fine art, set in beautiful gardens. Attend a cultural workshop (batik or silver jewelry making, ~IDR 200,000–300,000)
day_by_day.evening: Cooking class at Paon Bali or Casa Luna Cooking School — learn to make traditional Balinese dishes like lawar, satay lilit, and black rice pudding (~IDR 350,000–450,000 including market visit)

meals.breakfast: Seniman Coffee Studio, Ubud — specialty coffee, pastries, and light breakfast (~IDR 60,000–100,000)
meals.lunch: Eat what you cook at the cooking class, OR Warung Sopa — wholesome vegetarian Balinese food (~IDR 50,000–80,000)
meals.dinner: Enjoy your cooking class meal, or head to Night Market Ubud (Pasar Malam) for satay, grilled corn, and local snacks (~IDR 30,000–60,000)

day_by_day.notes: The Campuhan Ridge Walk is best done before 08:00 to avoid heat and crowds. Bring a light jacket for the early morning. Cooking class typically includes a morning market visit — confirm timing when booking.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Nusa Penida — take an early morning fast boat from Sanur Beach (~45 min, departs ~07:00–08:00, tickets ~IDR 200,000–250,000 each way). Visit the iconic Kelingking Beach viewpoint (T-Rex cliff) and Crystal Bay
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Nusa Penida: visit Angel's Billabong natural infinity pool and Broken Beach (Pasih Uug) — stunning natural arch over turquoise waters. Snorkel at Crystal Bay if time permits
day_by_day.evening: Return fast boat to Sanur (~16:00–17:00). Transfer back to Ubud. Rest and recovery evening

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast near Sanur before boarding — Warung Mak Beng (famous fried fish, opens early) or hotel breakfast to-go
meals.lunch: Warung on Nusa Penida (limited but available near Kelingking) — simple grilled fish, nasi campur (~IDR 50,000–80,000)
meals.dinner: Naughty Nuri's Warung, Ubud — famous BBQ ribs and cocktails after a long day (~IDR 150,000–220,000)

day_by_day.notes: Book fast boat tickets in advance during July (peak season). Hire a local driver/scooter on Nusa Penida (~IDR 150,000–200,000/day) as the island has limited transport. The descent to Kelingking Beach is steep — optional but rewarding. Wear non-slip shoes.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning after the Nusa Penida day trip. Gentle yin yoga or restorative class at Yoga Barn (09:30 class). Enjoy a slow morning at the hotel
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Penestanan and Sayan villages near Campuhan on foot or by bicycle — lush rice paddies, local temples, and traditional Balinese family compounds. Visit a local healer (balian) if interested (arrange through hotel)
day_by_day.evening: Sunset walk along Campuhan Ridge, followed by a relaxed dinner in the Campuhan area

meals.breakfast: In-hotel breakfast or Sayuri Healing Food Café — raw vegan and healing cuisine near Ubud (~IDR 80,000–120,000)
meals.lunch: Warung Teges or a local warung in Penestanan village — authentic home-cooked Balinese food (~IDR 35,000–55,000)
meals.dinner: Bridges Bali or Swept Away at Alaya Resort — riverside dining, Indonesian and international menu (~IDR 180,000–280,000)

day_by_day.notes: A rest day is important mid-trip. The Penestanan area is one of Ubud's most peaceful and authentic neighborhoods — great for photography and cultural immersion without crowds.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning drive to Mount Batur for a sunrise trek (depart ~02:00 from Ubud, ~1.5 hrs drive). Trek takes ~2 hrs to summit. Watch sunrise over the volcanic caldera and Lake Batur — one of Bali's most spectacular experiences
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend Mount Batur, stop at natural hot springs (Toya Bungkah) for a relaxing soak (~IDR 50,000–100,000). Drive back to Ubud via Kintamani with scenic lake views
day_by_day.evening: Early dinner and early bedtime — well-deserved rest after the trek

meals.breakfast: Banana and snacks at the summit (traditional — guides often bring eggs cooked in volcanic steam!)
meals.lunch: Warung Bajo, Kintamani — local food with panoramic views of the caldera (~IDR 60,000–90,000)
meals.dinner: Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka or light meal at a quiet café in Ubud (~IDR 50,000–100,000)

day_by_day.notes: Book a licensed guide for Mount Batur (~IDR 300,000–400,000 per person including guide). Bring warm layers — summit temperature can drop to 10–15°C before sunrise. Wear sturdy trekking shoes. This is a moderate trek suitable for average fitness levels.

day_by_day.morning: Beach day on the Bukit Peninsula (south Bali) — drive ~1.5 hrs to Balangan Beach or Bingin Beach, two of Bali's most beautiful and less crowded beaches with dramatic cliff backdrops
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue to Uluwatu Temple perched on a 70m cliff over the Indian Ocean (~30 min from Bingin). Explore the temple grounds and watch the resident monkeys
day_by_day.evening: Attend the legendary Kecak Fire Dance at Uluwatu Temple at sunset (~18:00, tickets ~IDR 150,000) — one of the most dramatic cultural performances in Bali with the ocean as backdrop

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or early café stop en route
meals.lunch: Single Fin Restaurant, Uluwatu — casual surf café with stunning cliff views over Suluban Beach (~IDR 120,000–180,000)
meals.dinner: Sundara Beach Club at Four Seasons Jimbaran or Jimbaran Bay seafood warung — fresh grilled seafood on the beach at sunset (~IDR 200,000–350,000)

day_by_day.notes: Balangan and Bingin beaches have limited parking — arrive by 10:00 to secure a spot. Keep belongings secure at Uluwatu Temple (monkeys steal glasses, phones, and bags). The Kecak performance sells out — buy tickets on arrival or book ahead.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga and meditation at Yoga Barn — join a special workshop or two-hour immersive class (Kundalini, AcroYoga, or sound healing, ~IDR 150,000–200,000). This is a dedicated yoga-focused morning
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Blanco Renaissance Museum in Ubud — the flamboyant studio-home of Spanish artist Antonio Blanco, filled with his Balinese-inspired artwork. Then explore Ubud's galleries along Jalan Raya Ubud
day_by_day.evening: Indulge in a full Balinese spa treatment — traditional 2-hour package including body scrub, flower bath, and massage at Taksu Spa or Karsa Spa (~IDR 300,000–450,000)

meals.breakfast: Kafe Ubud — organic granola, fresh fruit platters, and herbal teas (~IDR 70,000–100,000)
meals.lunch: Sari Organik, Ubud — organic rice field café accessible by a short walk through rice paddies (~IDR 80,000–130,000)
meals.dinner: Locavore, Ubud — one of Southeast Asia's top restaurants, innovative Indonesian tasting menu (book well in advance, ~IDR 600,000–900,000 for tasting menu — a splurge-worthy experience)

day_by_day.notes: Day 11 is a wellness-focused day to recharge before the final days. Locavore requires advance reservations — book at least 2–3 weeks ahead. If budget is a concern, Locavore NXT (their more casual sibling restaurant) is excellent at half the price.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to the north coast — drive ~2 hrs to Lovina Beach (black sand beach) and visit Gitgit Waterfall en route. Enjoy a dolphin watching boat tour at sunrise from Lovina (~IDR 100,000–150,000 per person, departs ~06:00)
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Brahma Vihara Arama — Bali's only Buddhist monastery with beautiful gardens and mountain views. Stop at Banjar Hot Springs (natural sulfuric springs) for a soak (~IDR 30,000 entry)
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud via the scenic mountain route through Bedugul and Handara Gate (iconic golf course gate perfect for photos). Arrive back in Ubud for a final evening

meals.breakfast: Early snack before dolphin tour; full breakfast at a Lovina café after (~IDR 50,000–80,000)
meals.lunch: Warung in Singaraja or Lovina — fresh North Balinese seafood and local specialties (~IDR 60,000–100,000)
meals.dinner: Mozaic Restaurant Ubud (if not visited earlier) or Barbecue night at Naughty Nuri's — a festive final full-day dinner (~IDR 150,000–250,000)

day_by_day.notes: Depart very early (04:30–05:00 from Ubud) to reach Lovina in time for the dolphin tour at sunrise. Hire a private driver for this full-day north Bali excursion (~IDR 600,000–700,000). Dolphin sightings are not guaranteed but very common in July.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise Campuhan Ridge Walk — a meaningful farewell to Ubud's iconic landscape. Pack light and take in the views one last time. Return for a leisurely hotel breakfast and checkout
day_by_day.afternoon: Last-minute souvenir shopping at Ubud Art Market — pick up Balinese crafts, silver jewelry, sarongs, paintings, and local coffee/spices. Visit a final temple or café you may have missed
day_by_day.evening: Transfer to airport for departure (allow 2–2.5 hrs from Ubud to airport). Farewell dinner near the airport or in Seminyak en route if time allows

meals.breakfast: Final hotel breakfast or Seniman Coffee — enjoy slowly before checkout
meals.lunch: Warung Teges or quick local warung near Ubud market — last taste of nasi campur (~IDR 35,000–55,000)
meals.dinner: Merah Putih Restaurant, Seminyak (en route to airport) — stunning venue celebrating Indonesian archipelago cuisine (~IDR 200,000–300,000), or airport dining if time is short

day_by_day.notes: Check out time is typically 12:00 — arrange late checkout or luggage storage with the hotel if your flight is in the evening. Budget ~IDR 300,000–400,000 for airport transfer from Ubud. Keep some IDR cash for last-minute purchases and airport tips.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Bali Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled. Private luxury transfer arranged from airport to Campuhan Ridge, Ubud Boutique Stay.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check-in and settle into your boutique suite at Campuhan Ridge. Enjoy a welcome drink and spa foot ritual offered by the property. Take a leisurely stroll along the iconic Campuhan Ridge Walk — a scenic 2 km trail through lush green rice paddies and jungle-clad hills, just steps from the hotel.
day_by_day.evening: Dinner at Bridges Bali, an award-winning fine-dining restaurant perched above the Campuhan River gorge, offering contemporary cuisine with spectacular valley views. End the night with a moonlit walk back along the ridge path.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable (in-flight or airport)
meals.lunch: Welcome lunch at the hotel's private terrace restaurant — seasonal Balinese dishes and fresh tropical juices
meals.dinner: Bridges Bali Restaurant, Campuhan — tasting menu with wine pairing; expect grilled barramundi, Wagyu beef tenderloin, and artisan desserts

day_by_day.notes: Request early check-in if available when booking. Wear comfortable walking shoes for the Campuhan Ridge Walk. The trail is best in the late afternoon light. Confirm private transfer with hotel concierge prior to arrival.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga session on the hotel's open-air pavilion overlooking the Campuhan valley — guided by a resident certified yoga instructor. Follow with a mindful breakfast on your private terrace.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the sacred Pura Gunung Lebah temple at the base of the Campuhan ridge, one of Ubud's oldest temples. Afterward, explore the Neka Art Museum, housing an outstanding collection of traditional and contemporary Balinese paintings and sculptures.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Kecak fire dance performance at Pura Dalem Ubud — a mesmerizing cultural spectacle held at sunset. Dinner at Locavore, one of Southeast Asia's most celebrated fine-dining restaurants, focusing on locally sourced Indonesian ingredients.

meals.breakfast: In-hotel private terrace breakfast — freshly baked pastries, tropical fruit platter, Balinese jamu shots, and specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Café Wayan, Ubud — wholesome Balinese rijsttafel set lunch with herbal teas
meals.dinner: Locavore Restaurant, Ubud — chef's tasting menu with Indonesian wine and cocktail pairings

day_by_day.notes: Book Locavore well in advance as tables fill up weeks ahead. Kecak performance tickets can be arranged by hotel concierge. Bring a light sarong for temple visits.

day_by_day.morning: Private sunrise yoga and pranayama session at Yoga Barn, Ubud's premier wellness center — choose from a curated class or book a one-on-one session with a senior instructor. Return to hotel for a nourishing breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in a 3-hour traditional Balinese spa journey at COMO Shambhala Estate, one of Asia's finest wellness retreats, located just minutes from Campuhan Ridge. Experience the signature herbal body scrub, hot stone massage, and floral bath ritual.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the rooftop bar of Alaya Resort Ubud. Dinner at Room4Dessert / Mozaic Restaurant Ubud — a Michelin-recognized dining experience with innovative French-Indonesian fusion cuisine.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast — smoothie bowls, avocado toast, eggs Benedict with smoked duck, and fresh-pressed juices
meals.lunch: Light post-spa lunch at COMO Shambhala's Glow restaurant — raw, organic, and ayurvedic-inspired dishes
meals.dinner: Mozaic Restaurant, Ubud — 7-course degustation menu with sommelier-selected wine pairings

day_by_day.notes: Pre-book COMO Shambhala spa treatments at least 3 days in advance. Yoga Barn classes fill quickly in peak season — reserve online. Mozaic requires a reservation; smart casual dress recommended.

day_by_day.morning: Private guided trekking experience through Ubud's surrounding rice terraces — explore the lesser-known Tegallalang upper trails and Ceking terraces with a local expert guide. Morning mist and golden light make for breathtaking scenery.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Blanco Renaissance Museum, home to the flamboyant works of Spanish-Balinese artist Antonio Blanco, set within a dramatic hillside mansion. Followed by a private Balinese cooking class at a luxury villa kitchen — learn to prepare traditional dishes using market-fresh ingredients.
day_by_day.evening: Dinner at Swept Away at Como Shambhala Estate — open-sided pavilion dining above a rushing jungle river, serving refined Asian and Western cuisine.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast — Balinese black rice porridge, fresh papaya with lime, omelets to order, and cold brew coffee
meals.lunch: Eat the dishes you prepared during your private cooking class, served in the villa setting with fresh coconut water
meals.dinner: Swept Away, COMO Shambhala Estate — grilled seafood platter, slow-roasted lamb, and house-crafted botanical cocktails

day_by_day.notes: Wear sturdy footwear and bring insect repellent for the rice terrace trek. The cooking class can be arranged through the hotel concierge with a private chef. Swept Away is romantic and ideal for candlelit dining — request a riverside table.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Seminyak Beach (approx. 1.5 hours by private car). Begin with a morning yoga session on the beach at sunrise with a private instructor — a transformative experience combining ocean air and gentle waves.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at Ku De Ta Beach Club or Potato Head Beach Club — Bali's most iconic luxury beach clubs. Enjoy a private cabana, infinity pool access, and world-class DJs. Snorkeling or stand-up paddleboarding available.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at Ku De Ta's terrace, famous for its panoramic Indian Ocean sunsets. Dinner at Merah Putih Restaurant, Seminyak — an architectural masterpiece serving elevated Indonesian cuisine in a stunning open-air setting.

meals.breakfast: Early light hotel breakfast — granola, yogurt, and fresh fruit before departure
meals.lunch: Beachside lunch at Ku De Ta or Potato Head — lobster rolls, tuna tataki, and fresh tropical cocktails
meals.dinner: Merah Putih, Seminyak — signature beef rendang, prawn satay, and artisan desserts with cocktail pairing

day_by_day.notes: Arrange a private luxury car and driver for the full day through your hotel. Book a cabana at Ku De Ta or Potato Head in advance. Bring reef-safe sunscreen and beach attire. Return to Ubud after dinner.

day_by_day.morning: Morning meditation and yin yoga session at the hotel pavilion. Afterward, visit the sacred Tirta Empul Temple in Tampaksiring (30 minutes from Ubud) — a holy water purification temple where you can participate in a traditional melukat cleansing ritual.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Gunung Kawi Royal Temple complex — a stunning 11th-century archaeological site carved into volcanic rock cliffs above a river valley. Private guided tour included. Return to the hotel for a restful afternoon by the pool.
day_by_day.evening: Private in-villa dining experience arranged by the hotel — a personal chef prepares a bespoke 5-course Balinese feast on your terrace under the stars, with curated wine selections.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast — eggs royale, tropical smoothies, freshly baked sourdough, and Balinese coffee
meals.lunch: Warung Teges, near Tirta Empul — authentic Balinese warung lunch with babi guling (suckling pig) and sate lilit
meals.dinner: Private in-villa chef's dinner on your terrace — 5-course Balinese tasting menu with imported wine selection

day_by_day.notes: Wear modest clothing (sarong provided) for Tirta Empul. The melukat ritual is spiritual — approach with respect. Arrange private chef dinner through hotel concierge at least 24 hours in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day excursion to Nusa Penida Island — depart early by private speedboat from Sanur Beach (1 hour from Ubud by car, 45-minute boat ride). Morning snorkeling at Crystal Bay with vibrant coral reefs and potential manta ray sightings.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the iconic Kelingking Beach viewpoint — one of Bali's most dramatic cliff-top vistas. Explore Angel's Billabong and Broken Beach natural rock formations. Swim in turquoise natural pools.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Sanur by speedboat and private transfer back to Ubud. Relaxing dinner at Hujan Locale, Ubud — a sophisticated Indonesian restaurant in a restored Dutch colonial building.

meals.breakfast: Early hotel breakfast — packed light and nutritious for the boat trip
meals.lunch: Picnic-style gourmet lunch box prepared by the hotel, enjoyed on Nusa Penida's cliffs with ocean views
meals.dinner: Hujan Locale, Ubud — modern Indonesian small plates, craft cocktails, and natural wines

day_by_day.notes: Book a private speedboat charter for comfort. Wear water shoes and bring waterproof bags. Kelingking Beach trail is steep — optional descent. Sea conditions in July are generally calm. Start early (6:00 AM) to maximize the day.

day_by_day.morning: Restorative morning — sleep in and enjoy a late breakfast. Book a private 90-minute Balinese deep tissue massage and aromatherapy session at the hotel's spa. Follow with a gentle hatha yoga class on the ridge.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Ubud's vibrant Jalan Raya Ubud art market and surrounding galleries. Visit the Ubud Palace (Puri Saren Agung) — a beautifully preserved royal compound. Browse high-end boutiques for Balinese crafts, textiles, and jewelry.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a private Legong dance performance arranged exclusively for hotel guests at a nearby royal compound. Dinner at Alaya Resort's Plantation Restaurant — farm-to-table cuisine with Balinese heritage recipes.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely late hotel breakfast — full Balinese set with nasi goreng, fresh juice bar, and artisan pastries
meals.lunch: Sari Organik, Ubud — organic rice field café accessible via a scenic walk through paddies; farm-fresh salads and smoothies
meals.dinner: Plantation Restaurant, Alaya Resort Ubud — grilled duck breast, jackfruit curry, and coconut panna cotta

day_by_day.notes: Negotiate respectfully at the art market but expect premium pricing for quality pieces. Private Legong performance can be arranged by hotel concierge for an intimate cultural experience. Carry cash for market shopping.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning private surf lesson at Canggu Beach (1.5 hours from Ubud by private car) — one of Bali's best surf spots for all levels. Two-hour lesson with a certified professional instructor and premium equipment.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Canggu's trendy beach village — visit Echo Beach for a swim, browse chic boutiques and concept stores. Relax at Finn's Beach Club with a private daybed and pool access.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset at Old Man's beach bar in Canggu — the quintessential Bali surfer-chic atmosphere. Dinner at Deus Ex Machina's restaurant or Crate Café for a premium casual dining experience before the private car returns you to Ubud.

meals.breakfast: Light early hotel breakfast — protein smoothie, eggs, and fruit before the surf lesson
meals.lunch: Lunch at Finn's Beach Club — premium beach club menu with grilled seafood, sushi platters, and tropical cocktails
meals.dinner: Deus Ex Machina Restaurant, Canggu — wood-fired pizzas, fresh pasta, and curated wine list in a creative temple-inspired space

day_by_day.notes: Arrange private car for the full Canggu day trip. Book surf lesson with a reputable school — hotel concierge can recommend certified instructors. Finn's Beach Club requires advance reservation for daybeds in peak season.

day_by_day.morning: Pre-dawn departure for Mount Batur sunrise trek — a guided private hike up Bali's active volcano (1,717 m). Reach the summit at sunrise for panoramic views over the caldera lake and surrounding peaks. Return to hotel by midday.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relaxation afternoon at the hotel — pool time, nap, and a soothing 60-minute reflexology session to recover from the morning trek. Light reading or journaling on your private terrace.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the hotel bar. Dinner at Room4Dessert by Will Goldfarb — Bali's world-famous dessert-first dining concept, a James Beard Award-winning experience that is utterly unique.

meals.breakfast: Pre-trek packed breakfast by the hotel — energy bars, bananas, and thermos coffee consumed at the volcano base
meals.lunch: Post-trek brunch at hotel — hearty Balinese rice bowl, fresh juices, and restorative herbal teas
meals.dinner: Room4Dessert, Ubud — avant-garde dessert tasting menu with wine and cocktail pairings; a once-in-a-lifetime dining experience

day_by_day.notes: Mount Batur trek departs at approximately 3:30 AM. Wear warm layers (it can be cold at the summit). Book a licensed private guide through the hotel. Room4Dessert requires advance reservation — book as early as possible.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga nidra (yogic sleep) and sound healing session at the hotel or Yoga Barn — deeply restorative after the volcano trek. Followed by a Balinese jamu wellness ritual — traditional herbal elixirs prepared by a local healer.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Penglipuran Village — one of Bali's best-preserved traditional villages, known for its pristine bamboo architecture and ancient customs. Private guided cultural tour with a local village elder. Browse handcrafted souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Scenic drive back through the highland countryside. Dinner at Kafe Batan Waru, Ubud — a long-standing institution serving authentic Indonesian cuisine in a warm, elegant setting.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast — açaí bowls, Balinese spiced porridge, fresh tropical platters, and specialty single-origin coffee
meals.lunch: Traditional lunch at a family compound in Penglipuran Village — home-cooked Balinese dishes as part of the cultural experience
meals.dinner: Kafe Batan Waru, Ubud — beef rendang, gado-gado, and pisang goreng dessert with imported wines

day_by_day.notes: Penglipuran Village is about 45 minutes from Ubud — arrange private car. Wear respectful clothing. The jamu ritual can be booked through the hotel's wellness team. This is a perfect slower-paced recovery day.

day_by_day.morning: Final beach day — private day trip to Jimbaran Bay (1.5 hours from Ubud). Morning yoga on the beach at sunrise followed by a swim in the calm, crystal-clear waters of this sheltered bay. Visit the famous Four Seasons Jimbaran for a spa treatment or beach club experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the GWK Cultural Park (Garuda Wisnu Kencana) — home to one of the world's tallest statues, a monumental tribute to Hindu mythology set against dramatic limestone cliffs. Private guided tour of the cultural grounds.
day_by_day.evening: The ultimate Jimbaran seafood feast — dine at a premium beachfront seafood grill on Jimbaran Bay as the sun sets over the Indian Ocean. Fresh lobster, grilled prawns, red snapper, and clams served with cold Bintang beer or white wine, feet in the sand.

meals.breakfast: Early light hotel breakfast before departure
meals.lunch: Lunch at Four Seasons Jimbaran Bay's Sundara Beach Club — premium beach club menu with fresh sashimi, grilled fish, and signature cocktails
meals.dinner: Jimbaran Bay beachfront seafood dinner — choose from Menega Café or Teba Mega Jimbaran for premium fresh catch grilled to order at sunset

day_by_day.notes: Book Sundara Beach Club at Four Seasons in advance. Jimbaran Bay seafood dining is one of Bali's most iconic experiences — arrive early to secure the best beachfront tables. Return to Ubud after dinner via private car.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise yoga session on the Campuhan Ridge — a mindful, reflective practice to close the journey. Pack mindfully and enjoy a long, indulgent farewell breakfast at the hotel.
day_by_day.afternoon: Last-minute exploration of Ubud's finest boutiques along Jalan Dewi Sita for premium Balinese artisan gifts, handwoven textiles, and locally crafted jewelry. Visit Ganesha Bookshop for curated books on Balinese culture and spirituality.
day_by_day.evening: Early evening private transfer to Ngurah Rai International Airport for departure. Farewell cocktail at the hotel before checkout — a final toast to an extraordinary Bali journey.

meals.breakfast: Grand farewell breakfast at the hotel — full spread of Balinese and Western favorites, fresh juice station, and specialty coffee bar
meals.lunch: Farewell lunch at Warung Ibu Oka, Ubud — the legendary babi guling (suckling pig) institution, a Balinese culinary icon
meals.dinner: Airport lounge dining or light bites before departure — hotel can arrange a premium packed meal for the journey

day_by_day.notes: Confirm checkout time and arrange luggage storage if needed for afternoon shopping. Allow at least 3 hours before flight for airport transfer and check-in. Ask the hotel concierge to arrange a garland blessing ceremony before departure — a beautiful Balinese farewell tradition.
